text:
Maya (AE): FYI Peregrine sent an RFI with a capability matrix and a few surprise asks: runbook for failover, per-tenant audit logs to customer S3, and a cost comparison vs self-hosting. They want answers in three business days.

Ravi - Solutions: Ok. Quick plan: 1) produce a short capability matrix export for procurement (2-pager), 2) a one-page POC runbook, 3) a pricing comparison table. I can draft the matrix today.

Jordan (Infra): For per-tenant audit log export we'll provide an S3 sink option. Need to know if they want push (our connector writes) or pull (they fetch exports). Push requires an IAM role with write access. Example minimal policy for push:

```
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Action": ["s3:PutObject", "s3:PutObjectAcl"],
      "Resource": ["arn:aws:s3:::peregrine-logs/*"]
    }
  ]
}
```

Ravi - Solutions: Good, include that snippet in the RFI response. Also they asked about HSM vendor support. We support Thales and Luna, and AWS CloudHSM for KMS. Note: if they need FIPS 140-3 validated appliance on-prem, we need model number to confirm.

Maya (AE): Procurement also asked for a brief section describing rollback/exit for the POC and what artifacts they keep. Legal wants to confirm we won't retain keying material unless customer opts in.

LegalBot: Template clause: "Customer retains sole ownership of cryptographic keys; Redwood may only store key references for orchestration. Upon contract termination we will coordinate zeroization within mutually agreed timeframe." I'll attach the boilerplate.

ProdOps: For the 4-week POC we need a clear acceptance criteria doc: perf targets (p95 under X ms at Y qps), data sync tests, and security checklist. I can draft an acceptance template.

Ravi - Solutions: I'll assemble a compact capability matrix. Quick draft inline: 

```
Capability | Supported | Notes
Tenant-level audit export | Yes | Push to customer S3 via IAM role or presigned export
Customer-managed keys (HSM) | Yes | PKCS#11 connector; list supported vendors
Private control plane | Yes | VPC peering or VPN; Private deployment requires network prep
POC duration | 4 weeks | Onboard, integrate, tune, acceptance
Pricing model | Usage + reserved | Provide POC credit and 90-day promo option
```

Maya (AE): Can we include a short cost delta line "approx 40-60% lower TCO vs their current stack"? We need to substantiate with numbers. Jordan, can you give ballpark infra cost per month for Dedicated medium pool and for a comparable self-hosted cluster (GPU + ops)?

Jordan (Infra): Ballpark: Dedicated medium pool ~ $45k/month (incl infra amortized), self-hosted comparable (including ops headcount amortized) ~ $80-120k/month depending on utilization and ops. I'll prepare a 3-line comparison for procurement.

Ravi - Solutions: Action list: 1) I will export the capability matrix and RFI responses by tomorrow noon. 2) Jordan: cost comparator + p95/p99 numbers for standard 8k and extended 32k contexts by EOD tomorrow. 3) LegalBot: attach boilerplate key ownership text and POC terms. 4) Maya: coordinate with customer to get HSM model and preferred log export method.

Maya (AE): Looping in Emily (peregrine) now to request HSM model and expected throughput. Emily, please share network diagram and whether you prefer S3 push or periodic export.

Emily (Peregrine) joined: Thanks Maya. We'll send the diagram and the HSM make/model by tomorrow. Prefer push to S3 with per-tenant prefixes. Also we require 12 months retention and the ability to restrict exports to specific roles.

Ravi - Solutions: Perfect. We'll include retention and role-restriction info in the RFI packet. I'll mark the matrix with checkboxes for each of Peregrine's asks.

Maya (AE): Great work team. I'll assemble packet and send to procurement once I have Jordan's numbers and Ravi's matrix. :thumbsup:
